title: George and the Dinosaur Under the Blanket

learning.summary_zh: 睡前 George 與膽小的 Big Eye 發現棉被下有聲響；房間不可思議地變了，他們幫迷路的小恐龍 Nibble 找巢；早晨棉被上留下一片蕨葉。
focus_en: Bedtime words: blanket, whisper, glow, adventure
Observation: footprint, look carefully, I can see
Key phrases: Hold my hand. Stay close to me. You are home now.
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：棉被下面的 thump 是什麼？（小恐龍 Nibble，不是怪獸）
問：Big Eye 很怕的時候，George 說了什麼？（Hold my hand / Look carefully / We can still be brave）
問：他們怎麼找到 nest？（腳印 + 星星夜燈 + Big Eye 幫忙看）
問：醒來後留下什麼證據？（一片小蕨葉）

pages.alt: Daddy reads a bedtime story while George holds Big Eye

lines.text: It was late, and George was tucked under his warm blanket in the big bed.
Daddy sat beside him and read one last story from the phone.
Just one more chapter, George. Then it is time to sleep.
Can Big Eye listen too? He likes adventures.

pages.alt: George hugs Big Eye as the room grows dark

lines.text: When the story ended, Daddy kissed George good night and turned off the main light.
Only the little star lamp was left, glowing softly beside the bed.
Good night, Big Eye. Hold my hand until I fall asleep.

pages.alt: Something thumps under the cream blanket

lines.text: George had almost closed his eyes when something under the blanket went thump, thump, thump.
George, did you hear that? Something is moving under the blanket!
My feet did not move. Let us look again, very carefully.

pages.alt: Big Eye blinks three times and the room begins to change

lines.text: Big Eye blinked once, twice, then three times, and a soft green light filled the room.
The grey curtains shone like silver trees, and the blanket rose beneath them like a hill.
Big Eye, what is happening to our room?

pages.alt: The blanket becomes a mountain with ferns growing beside the sheet

lines.text: The blanket had become a soft green mountain, with a pillow cave at the very top.
Small green ferns grew beside the sheet, and tiny footprints led up the slope.
Look! I can see tiny footprints on the mountain!
We should follow them. Stay close to me, Big Eye.

pages.alt: George lifts a fold in the blanket mountain while Big Eye hides behind him

lines.text: They climbed a little way when another thump came from behind a fold in the blanket.
Hold my hand, Big Eye. I will look first, and you can stay right behind me.
All right, but please do not let go of my hand.

pages.alt: A tiny dinosaur peeks out from behind the blanket

lines.text: George lifted the fold gently, and a tiny dinosaur peeked out with round, worried eyes.
A dinosaur! George, it might be a monster!
Look carefully, Big Eye. It is little, and it looks frightened, not fierce.

pages.alt: Nibble tells George she cannot find her nest

lines.text: Peep! Peep! I cannot find my nest anywhere!
Do not worry, little one. We will help you. Which way is home?
My nest smells like warm leaves, near a pale cave at the top of the hill.

pages.alt: George holds the star night-light while Big Eye spots footprints

lines.text: The footprints go towards the curtain forest! I can see them clearly.
George raised the star lamp high, and its warm beam lit a narrow path between the curtains.
One step at a time. Nibble, follow the footprints with us.

pages.alt: George and Big Eye walk through the darker curtain forest

lines.text: Beneath the tall curtains, the path grew darker, and Big Eye began to tremble.
It is too dark in here! What if something big is hiding in the curtain forest?
We can be quiet, but we can still be brave. I am right beside you.

pages.alt: Nibble curls up in her nest near the pillow cave

lines.text: At last they reached the pillow cave, where a nest of warm leaves waited in the moonlight.
My nest! We found it! Peep, peep!
You are home now, Nibble. Sleep well in your warm nest.
I was scared, but I kept looking, and we found the way.

pages.alt: George wakes up and finds a tiny fern leaf on his blanket

lines.text: In the morning, George woke beside Big Eye and found a tiny green fern leaf on the blanket.
Daddy, look! Where did this leaf come from? It was not here last night.
I do not know, George. It looks very strange. Do you know where it came from?
